attributes.name: backdrop
attributes.description: Displays a backdrop behind the modal.

attributes.name: breakout
attributes.description: Allows the modal to ignore the default containment constraints.

attributes.name: fixed
attributes.description: Positions the modal relative to the viewport.

attributes.name: margin
attributes.description: Margin used when the modal is contained by the viewport.

attributes.name: outside-click
attributes.description: Closes the modal when the user clicks outside it.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-modal>` element displays modal content above the page.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Activate the page's trigger to open the panel. |
| Using the component | Use its controls or links, then close it with the available dismissal control. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Moves to the next focusable control and wraps inside the modal. |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Moves to the previous focusable control and wraps inside the modal. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Closes the modal. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
